title: Subject Strength of 16 Chinese Universities: GRAS 2026, ARWU Indicators and Highly Cited Researchers 2025

university_id.description: Stable slug of the university, the same id as in the other Long Bet datasets.

subject_category.description: GRAS subject category: Natural Sciences, Engineering, Life Sciences, Medical Sciences, Social Sciences.

gras_2026_rank.description: Rank in the GRAS 2026 subject list as published: a number for places 1-50, a band (e.g. `51-75`, `151-200`) beyond, or `not in published list (top N)` when the university is not in a list that is published to place N.

published_list_length.description: How far down the subject list is published (50, 100, 200, 300, 400 or 500 places).

source_url.description: Page(s) the figure was read from, "; "-separated.
